tara (AE): Prospect asks for BYOK with HSM-backed KEKs and strict no-plaintext requirement. Need a short presales note + ask list for a 2-week POC.
ben (SEC): We support: EKM/proxy (no keys stored), wrapped-DEK import (customer wraps with KEK/HSM), and client-side encryption. We'll draft CAIQ-friendly snippets stating no plaintext is required.
arya (SRE): For Private deployments: options are mTLS KMS proxy (outbound-only), signed offline import bundle for air-gapped, or local forwarder agent. DEKs cached in-memory; unwrap on start/rotation only.
luca (SE): Latency: unwrap during init/rotation only, expect ~50-180ms depending on region. Cost: mostly on the customer KMS/HSM side; note potential egress.
tara (AE): Ask list to share with customer?
ben (SEC): 1) KMS/HSM vendor and endpoints, 2) Admin contact + PKI for mTLS or signed bundle, 3) Rotation cadence, 4) SIEM endpoint and preferred format, 5) Outbound connectivity allowance or air-gap status.
arya (SRE): I'll drop a runbook skeleton with sample logs to drive (syslog/HTTPS) and an import script.
bot-presales: Ticket POC-234 created for BYOK/HSM presales (owner: tara).
tara (AE): Thanks — I'll forward ask list and schedule kickoff once we have PKI and endpoints. :thumbsup:
